description: Election Commission - The revision of registers of electors for the year 2017 has commenced on 15th May 2017
reasoning: This gazette content announces the commencement of the 2017 revision of electoral registers under the Registration of Electors Act. It specifies the locations where electoral registers will be exhibited, describes the process for public inspection of registers, and outlines the enumeration process for collecting voter information. The content specifically deals with electoral processes and voter registration matters, falling squarely under the Elections category (Type 7).
